queries.query: Palu Indonesia official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry BPN geoportal
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Kantor Pertanahan Kota Palu, the ATR/BPN BHUMI spatial portal, and the ATR/BPN ATLAS portal. BHUMI documentation describes an open interactive geospatial land-information platform; the bounded anonymous inspection did not yield a safe Palu parcel feature response.

officialSources.observation: Official Kantor Pertanahan Kota Palu site identifies the local ATR/BPN land office and its public service channel.
Palu land-office service page lists land registration, land information, surveying and parcel mapping services, establishing a local cadastral custodian.
Official ATR/BPN BHUMI guidance describes a public interactive geospatial platform for land and spatial data, with accuracy/completeness disclaimers and public-information limits.
Official ATR/BPN ATLAS portal loaded and describes spatial datasets; the public catalog exposed no Palu parcel feature service in this bounded attempt.
Official Palu municipal spatial-planning and land office site confirms the city land/spatial custodian and public publication role, but exposes no anonymous parcel API in the inspected page.
